entry.title: Inter‐Rater Reliability of AI Scores: A Call to Move from Correlational to Factor Analytical Estimation
entry.reading_note:
Reading depth: a reading recommendation; full-paper reading is not established.
Speer, A. B. (2026). Inter-Rater Reliability of AI Scores: A Call to Move from Correlational to Factor Analytical Estimation. Personnel Psychology. doi:10.1111/peps.70036 (catalog W026)
*What they did:* Argues that AI and expert scores should not be treated as parallel measures. It proposes congeneric factor-model reliability, using the squared standardized AI loading, and supports it with a Monte Carlo study of incomplete rater designs.
*Access:* CC BY 4.0 at Wiley; open it manually because of the bot check.
